Sydney Teen Boys Accused of Gang Rape Granted Bail

Two 17-year-old boys accused of participating in a gang rape in Sydney have been granted bail. The court heard that the teenagers allegedly messaged two other individuals to join in what was described as a "degrading" and "humiliating" assault. The alleged incident involved a teenage girl and lasted for hours. The two accused are among three 17-year-olds facing charges related to the event.
